title: Every replay reaches your profile
summary: When many replays were waiting to upload, the game sent them all at once and some of them never reached phigros.tools. Uploads now leave one after another, so each replay, play and save arrives.

spans.text: When many replays were waiting to upload, the game sent them all at once and some of them never reached phigros.tools. Uploads now leave one after another, so each replay, play and save arrives.

title: See what your friends are playing
summary: Your friends now show in the game with the chart they are on, and a tap watches their play live. Rooms also keep a queue of charts that anyone can add to.

spans.text: Your friends now show in the game with the chart they are on, and a tap watches their play live. Rooms also keep a queue of charts that anyone can add to.
Friends
Add a friend with their name and number, like
Name#0042
, or by tapping a player's row in a room.
Friends who are playing show first with their chart, and tapping one watches their play live.
A friend can invite you into their room. Tapping the toast joins it.
Appear invisible
shows you offline to everyone, and
Allow spectating
decides whether friends can watch you.
Your friends are also on
phigros.tools
once your browser is signed in to your profile.
A queue for every room
In a room, starting a song adds it to the queue, up to 20 charts and 3 from one player.
The host orders the queue by holding a chart and dragging it to its place.
Everyone plays the room's chart at their own level and with their own modifiers.
The host can rename the room, or hand it over to another player.
Fixes
Moving a paused song no longer lets it run ahead of its music.
The friend requests that came while the game was closed are told together at launch.
Toasts are drawn like the game's own bars, at the bottom left.

title: Phigros++ on iPhone and iPad
summary: Phigros++ now runs on iOS, with everything it has on Android. phigros.tools patches your copy of the game in your browser, and nothing is uploaded.

spans.text: Phigros++ now runs on iOS, with everything it has on Android. phigros.tools patches your copy of the game in your browser, and nothing is uploaded.
Patched in your browser
Choose your decrypted copy of Phigros on the
Phigros++ page
: your browser turns it into
Phigros++.ipa
on your device.
SideStore or AltStore installs it next to the game, signed with a free Apple ID.
What it patches the game with is signed by the release key of Phigros++, and checked before anything is patched.

title: Rooms for up to 8 players
summary: Everyone in a room plays the same chart at the same time, with each other's scores on screen as the song goes.

spans.text: Everyone in a room plays the same chart at the same time, with each other's scores on screen as the song goes.
Open rooms
The tab with two people on the chapter screen lists the open rooms, with the chart each one plays.
Create a room
makes yours. With a password only the players who type it join, and nothing it plays shows on phigros.tools.
A room without a password shows live on
phigros.tools
and keeps its matches there.
In a room
The first player is the host, under a golden crown, and starts the match once everyone is ready.
Everyone plays at the same time, with each other's scores on screen as the song goes.
Up to 8 more players can spectate, and watch any player's play live.
Chat lines only go to the players in the room: they are never kept.

title: Play any chart with modifiers
summary: Play any chart easier, harder, faster or in the dark. A Modifiers switch on the song list opens nine of them, each with what it gives the score.

spans.text: Play any chart easier, harder, faster or in the dark. A Modifiers switch on the song list opens nine of them, each with what it gives the score.
Nine ways to play a chart
Easy
and
Hard Rock
widen or narrow the timing windows.
Half Time
and
Nightcore
play the song at 0.75× or 1.25×.
Hidden
fades the notes out before their line, and
Flashlight
only shows them near it.
Sudden Death
ends the song when the combo breaks, and
Perfect
starts it again at anything but a perfect.
Random
moves the notes to other lanes.
What a play with modifiers counts for
Nothing in the game: your save and records stay what the game itself gives.
Its replay is kept, and your best with each set of modifiers goes to the chart's Modifiers leaderboard on phigros.tools.
The total is the score times each modifier's multiplier.

title: Restart a song without loading
summary: Restarting a song no longer goes through a loading screen: it starts again where you are. The HUD also counts your judgements under the combo.

spans.text: Restarting a song no longer goes through a loading screen: it starts again where you are. The HUD also counts your judgements under the combo.
While you play
The grade and accuracy the play is heading for show under the score.
A timing bar shows how early or late each hit was.
Your perfects, goods, bads and misses count under the combo.
Between plays
Instant restart
starts the song again from the pause menu, or by holding pause, without loading.
The
SKIP button
jumps over a song's intro or ending.
The result screen shows the RKS the play gave you.
Every one of these is a switch in the Phigros++ settings.

title: Install mods from the settings
summary: The settings have a Mods tab: the mods players published, each with what it shows and what it does, installed and updated with one tap.

spans.text: The settings have a Mods tab: the mods players published, each with what it shows and what it does, installed and updated with one tap.
The catalog
Every mod of the
catalog
is listed with its author, version and size.
A switch turns an installed mod on or off, and
Update all
brings the new releases in.
Install from GitHub
installs any other mod from the link of its repository, behind a warning.
A page for each mod
A mod's page shows its clip and its README, with links you can tap.
Each release is signed by its author, and the game checks the signature before installing it.
A mod with settings gets a tab of its own next to the game's.
Writing one takes a few lines of Lua: the
wiki
says how.

title: Watch any play again
summary: Every play is recorded and can be watched again, yours and the 50 best of each chart on phigros.tools. A trophy on the chapter screen opens the players ranked by RKS.

spans.text: Every play is recorded and can be watched again, yours and the 50 best of each chart on phigros.tools. A trophy on the chapter screen opens the players ranked by RKS.
Replays
The clock next to Play lists the chart's replays, laid out like the song list.
A tap while watching shows a player: seek, pause, 5 seconds back or forward, and a speed from 0.25× to 16×.
The seek bar marks every good, bad and miss where it happened.
The game judges a replay exactly as it judged the play, so what you watch is what was played.
Leaderboard
The trophy lists the players of phigros.tools by RKS.
Verified only
counts the plays whose replay the site judged again.

title: Your profile on phigros.tools
summary: Turn on Sync to phigros.tools in the game's Profile settings and your save, records and replays follow you to phigros.tools, under your Phigros name and a number of your own.

spans.text: Turn on
Sync to phigros.tools
in the game's Profile settings and your save, records and replays follow you to
phigros.tools
, under your Phigros name and a number of your own.
A profile that is yours
Your name gets a number, like
Name#0042
, and a page on phigros.tools to share.
Your save goes after each song, the replay of each play that beats a record, and a summary of every song you finish.
Each of these has its own switch, and
Unlisted profile
keeps you out of the leaderboards.
16 words and a code
Turning sync on shows 16 words: they are the password of your profile, and bring it back on any device.
Sign in another device
shows a code that works once, for 10 minutes. Type it on the other device, or on phigros.tools to sign your browser in.
Sign out
forgets this device, and the Devices list on phigros.tools removes any other.
